description: Service level objectives of the engine (D-069 item 6).

slo.dashboard_path.description: Where scripts/dashboard writes the generated Markdown, relative to the repository root; the path is gitignored and a PR never commits it (P-10).

slo.gate_failure_rate_max_percent.description: Highest share of failed tier-1 gate verdicts among the last slo.sample_window_events: none (D-337, the target is the whole; it was 20, a first value plan v3 §9.2 never set). A red verdict breaches it, and slo.breached asks the PR that removes the cause.

slo.gate_tier1_p95_s.description: Tier-1 gate wall time (sum of its stages) that the slo.percentile percentile (100, the slowest, D-337) of the last slo.sample_window_events tier-1 verdicts may not exceed. First value: the existing target gate.tier1_target_s (D-065 (5)); the reader enforces the smaller of the two, and a test refuses an SLO looser than that target.

slo.merged_hold_s.description: How long the merge pace must hold: the rolling window is checked at every merge of the last slo.merged_hold_s seconds of the log (plan v3 §9.2: at least 3 hours). Until the log covers the hold plus one window the SLO reports no data.

slo.merged_prs_per_hour_min.description: Fewest pr.merged events allowed in any slo.merged_window_s window, the pace of 1,000 PRs a day (plan v3 §9.2: the last 42 merges within 60 minutes).

slo.merged_window_s.description: Length of the window in which slo.merged_prs_per_hour_min merges must land (plan v3 §9.2: 60 minutes).

slo.min_samples.description: Fewest samples an SLO needs before it can breach; below it the SLO reports no data (the same size as gate.slow_window_events).

slo.percentile.description: Percentile the *_p95_s SLOs judge (nearest rank): 100, the whole sample, so the slowest value of the window decides (D-336, D-337: the target is always the whole; a percentile below 100 only reports, never accepts). The key names keep p95 as identifiers.

slo.producer.description: Producer name of slo.breached and of the reader's own engine.step.measured; part of every event id.

slo.report_quantiles.description: Diagnostic report-only percentiles (nearest rank) printed alongside the accepted p100 for run-durations validations (M4, D-337: external scales only report, never accept).

slo.sample_window_events.description: Most recent samples (tier-1 verdicts, merged PRs) each SLO value is computed over.

slo.snapshot_max_merges.description: Most first-parent merges on main a validation snapshot (runs, slo, verdicts) may trail before scripts/runs rebuilds it, even when less than a day has passed (M3).

slo.step.description: engine.step.measured step name of one reader run.

slo.train_queue_time_p95_s.description: Queue time (pr.ready to pr.merged of the same head) that the slo.percentile percentile (100, the slowest, D-337) of the last slo.sample_window_events merged PRs may not exceed. First value: three tier-2 runs of about 240 s (premise P-15, plan v3 §9.2) plus margin; tuned by a PR when slo.breached asks.
